Still unavailable, via 'no exact match' rather than a detected conflict — an intentional, documented asymmetry with the comma-delimited case above, not a special case for internship (internship is never masked or treated as inert here).

Proves 'not full-time or part-time' cannot leak part_time.

title: Full/Time
note: Codex review finding 2: a slash is not a transparent separator; it tokenizes as its own token, so 'Full/Time' produces a 3-token sequence that does not equal the 2-token full_time bare phrase, unlike the accepted 'Full-Time'/'Full Time' spellings.

title: Full—Time

title: Part,Time

note: A hyphen with whitespace on both sides is a prose dash, not the glued compound-word joiner in the accepted 'full-time' spelling; it is left un-normalized and tokenizes as its own hard token, breaking the match, unlike 'full-time' (glued) or 'full time' (plain space, no hyphen at all).
